# Winifred Tolley

## Overview

- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019)</sub>
- **Titles:** Miss  <sub>[v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037)</sub>; Mrs. Ambrose Kerr  <sub>[v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>; Mrs. Kerr  <sub>[v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Miss Winifred  <sub>[v4 c8 P15](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0015), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)</sub>

## Appearance

Winifred possesses a healthy, circular, pink-and-white complexion and cheerful brown eyes. She secures her small, rigid bun of blonde hair with a firm elastic band under a large sun-hat, eschewing hat pins. By her later years, she maintains a comfortable, cozy, and motherly figure.

_Sources: [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000)_

## Personality

Winifred is a outspoken, sharp-tongued, and practical woman who consistently expresses a disdain for men, holding them in contempt and frequently criticizing their behavior. Despite her stern opinions, sharp wit, and vocal antipathy toward Methodists, she is deeply compassionate, generous, and devoted to helping children and neighbors in distress. She possesses an intuitive ability to recognize like-minded spirits and brings immense humor and warmth to her close friendships.

_Sources: [v4 c6 P37](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0037), [v4 c6 P38](../source/v04-c06.md#nw-v04-c06-p0038), [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 c8 P27](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0027), [v4 c8 P59](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0059), [v4 c8 P79](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0079), [v4 c18 P15](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0015), [v5 c2 P41](../source/v05-c02.md#nw-v05-c02-p0041)_

## History

Winifred resided in Seven Gulls, where she established a reputation for her skilled needlework, excellent baking, and vehement disdain for men and Methodists. Upon meeting Nell Carrow, she quickly recognized her as a like-minded spirit and formed a close friendship with her and her husband Hugh, frequently visiting their house and engaging in verbal sparring matches with Captain Saul Garrick. She acted as a protective confidante and closest friend to Lorna Vane, providing guidance during Lorna's personal trials. After staying unmarried for many years, she surprised her friends by agreeing to marry her longtime suitor, Ambrose Kerr, though locals continued to call her Miss Winifred for over a decade. In later years, she took in an orphaned girl named Mary Stubbs to raise her in a good home, and she actively looked out for the well-being of the minister's children at the Glen manse.

_Sources: [v4 c8 P19](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0019), [v4 c8 P27](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0027), [v4 c8 P59](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0059), [v4 c8 P74](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0074), [v4 c8 P75](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0075), [v4 c10 P38](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0038), [v4 c18 P15](../source/v04-c18.md#nw-v04-c18-p0015), [v4 c37 P9](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0009), [v4 c37 P10](../source/v04-c37.md#nw-v04-c37-p0010), [v5 c1 P0](../source/v05-c01.md#nw-v05-c01-p0000), [v5 c9 P42](../source/v05-c09.md#nw-v05-c09-p0042)_

## Background by volume

- Was an only child for eight years before a younger brother was born  <sub>[v4 c34 P26](../source/v04-c34.md#nw-v04-c34-p0026)</sub>
- Her only brother passed away fifteen years prior to a local revival  <sub>[v4 c28 P7](../source/v04-c28.md#nw-v04-c28-p0007)</sub>
- Her mother's name was Nell  <sub>[v4 c8 P79](../source/v04-c08.md#nw-v04-c08-p0079)</sub>
- Won the award for lemon pies at the Port Marlow Exhibition  <sub>[v4 c10 P35](../source/v04-c10.md#nw-v04-c10-p0035)</sub>
